concepts.description: A branch of chemistry that deals with the relationships between heat and other forms of energy in chemical reactions and physical changes.
concepts.name: Chemical Thermodynamics

concepts.description: A thermodynamic potential that combines enthalpy and entropy, used to predict the spontaneity of a chemical reaction at constant temperature and pressure.
concepts.name: Gibbs Free Energy

concepts.description: States that energy is conserved and is applied through enthalpy to understand energy changes in chemical reactions.
concepts.name: First Law of Thermodynamics

concepts.description: Introduces the concept of entropy, defining it as a measure of disorder within a system.
concepts.name: Second Law of Thermodynamics

concepts.description: A thermodynamic property used to quantify the heat exchanged in chemical reactions, particularly when applying the First Law of Thermodynamics.
concepts.name: Enthalpy

concepts.description: A thermodynamic property that quantifies the degree of disorder or randomness within a system, central to the Second Law of Thermodynamics.
concepts.name: Entropy
